source='''from collections import Counter

def _regular(indices):
    return len(indices) >= 2 and len(set(b - a for a, b in zip(indices, indices[1:]))) == 1

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = []
    for r in grid:
        color, count = Counter(r).most_common(1)[0]
        row_modes.append(color)
    col_modes = []
    for j in range(w):
        color, count = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)).most_common(1)[0]
        col_modes.append(color)
    colors = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)
    line_color = None
    for color in colors:
        rows = [i for i, c in enumerate(row_modes) if c == color]
        cols = [j for j, c in enumerate(col_modes) if c == color]
        if _regular(rows) and _regular(cols):
            line_color = color
            break
    if line_color is None:
        raise ValueError("could not identify grid-line color")
    rows = [i for i, c in enumerate(row_modes) if c == line_color]
    cols = [j for j, c in enumerate(col_modes) if c == line_color]
    marked = [(ri, ci, grid[r][c]) for ri, r in enumerate(rows) for ci, c in enumerate(cols) if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    minr = min(p[0] for p in marked)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in marked)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in marked)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in marked)
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(minc, maxc)] for _ in range(minr, maxr)]
